testimonials.title: Saving Little Lives: Rare Tumour Surgery at ILS Hospitals | Patient Success Story |
testimonials.content_html:
At ILS Hospitals, we recently treated little Soumya, a 14-month-old from Bilaspur, who was suffering from a rare tumour near her urinary tract. She faced severe difficulty with urination and bowel movements. Our expert surgical team, performed a complex surgery, which was a complete success.

Today, Soumya is doing well, and has been discharged safely. Stories like hers inspire us to continue providing compassionate care and advanced treatment for every child.

Because true wellness begins with what’s on your plate.

testimonials.content_html: A challenging case, expertly handled at ILS Hospitals Howrah. Mrs. Rupali Chatterjee, with a history of hypothyroidism and diabetes, was admitted under Dr. Dolly Bosu Chaudhuri (Obstetrics and Gynaecology) for a sudden rupture of membrane. Our team successfully delivered a 1.2 kg baby girl through IVF, providing immediate NICU care. Special thanks to Dr. Lalit Agarwal, Consultant Paediatrician, for his invaluable expertise. Both mother and child were discharged healthy.
